Components Included 1 Receiver, 5 Transmitters

Product Detail

  • NO: Normally open pin
  • COM: Common pin
  • NC: Normally closed pin
  • L: Live input terminal (AC 100V-250V)
  • N: Neutral input terminal
  • Learning button on receiver – for programming modes and resetting
  • Indicator LED on receiver – provides visual feedback
  • Antenna on receiver – for signal reception
  • 5 x Transmitters (remote controls) – each with ON/OFF buttons, powered by CR2016 or CR2032 batteries
